scope.auxiliaryViews: Cannot inherit main-view CPU state or native history slots

ownership.stableViewKey: Positive process-local Int64 allocated once per view owner; never reused; not serialized as float or GPU identity
ownership.pipeline: Exact PostProcessing instance owns one CPU timeline and the matching registry/native history slots
ownership.invocation: Positive Int64 per actual view render, distinct from stableViewKey and engine frame index
ownership.cameraReplacement: Invalidate the shared owner timeline and GPU histories; no cache of retired cameras
ownership.hotPath: Fixed-size inline snapshots and one pending/committed slot; O(1); no dictionaries, LINQ, heap arrays, GL queries or pixel readback

snapshot.capture: After active generation publication, camera PrepareForDrawing, target/scale preparation and SharedVariables.UpdateMatrices; before the first temporal consumer or World draw
snapshot.immutability: All commands in one invocation reuse the same captured values, independent of their targets
snapshot.extent: Actual full-view color/depth render width and height, excluding command downsample targets and desktop window size; each positive integer <=16777216 for exact Vec2 float representation
snapshot.unavailable: No world/view, auxiliary view or absent temporal dependency is unavailable; never manufacture initialized identity history
snapshot.invalidHistory: Available snapshot with history_valid=false, nonzero reset mask and previous fields copied from their current counterparts
snapshot.invalidCurrentSample: Nonfinite/noninvertible current inputs are unavailable; reject temporal participation and invalidate owner before writes instead of manufacturing fallback matrices
snapshot.validity: Host predecessor continuity only; consumers must also check their own GPU history validity, bounds, depth and scene class

sampleIndex.advance: One unchecked +1 after successful output and history advance; no command-level advance
sampleIndex.reset: Restart at zero on discontinuity; failed/abandoned attempt never consumes a sample
sampleIndex.wrap: UInt32 modulo 4294967296; wrapping does not invalidate history or identify a view
sampleIndex.skippedView: No capture, write, index advance or timestamp commit; next render measures the real interval

transaction.commit: After World, AfterDraw, AfterFinal, ScreenOutput and native/logical frame-state restoration succeed; GPU history advance succeeds before nonthrowing CPU commit
transaction.duplicateRender: Reject a second full temporal render of the same owner in the same engine frame before history writes; invalidate owner; next frame falls back
transaction.failure: Discard pending CPU snapshot, invalidate timing and all owned GPU histories including pending commits; preserve slot identity without claiming rollback of pixels already written
transaction.failedCandidate: Do not capture or mutate the active timeline, options or native history
transaction.successfulPublication: New generation starts invalid even if the source, options or camera appear equivalent

renderDelta.compatibility: Keep existing small-state v1 semantics; temporal history can be invalid while small-state delta remains valid, e.g. a position cut

cameraCutPolicy.orientation: Compare separately normalized forward and up vectors; either dot < 0.5 resets, including roll; exactly 60 degrees is accepted
cameraCutPolicy.position: Euclidean distance between successful previous and current world positions; >16 resets, exactly 16 is accepted
cameraCutPolicy.invalidCamera: Nonfinite position/matrix/basis, zero basis or noninvertible projection is invalid
cameraCutPolicy.explicitReset: A host camera cut can reset even below thresholds; package AST cannot override host continuity

coordinates.hostMatrices: Engine row vectors: world * View * Projection; View includes full world translation
coordinates.uniformMatrices: M11,M12,...,M44 uploaded with transpose=false form GLSL column matrices equal to transpose(Engine matrix)
coordinates.depth: Host projection clip.z/clip.w is [0,1]; standard OPENGL_POSITION_FIX maps z to 2*z-w, so sampled depth stays host [0,1]
coordinates.reconstruction: inverse(render_projection) * vec4(uv*2-1, rawDepth, 1); divide by w; inverse(view) yields absolute world
coordinates.reprojection: previous_projection * previous_view * world; divide by w; previous UV = previous NDC.xy*0.5+0.5
coordinates.relativeAlternative: For precision, rotate current view position into current camera-relative world; add currentPosition-previousPosition once; use rotation-only previous view
coordinates.sky: Direction vectors use w=0 through view transforms, omitting camera translations; sky/class/depth rejection is a consumer requirement
coordinates.framebufferUV: Full-view texture UV, bottom-left origin; +jitterPixels moves toward increasing texture x/y
coordinates.presentation: UI top-left conversion, framebuffer y flips, reduced Z or other depth encodings require an explicit adapter; no implicit reuse of the main-view reconstruction

jitter.enable: Separate G6 opt-in with complete scene coverage; reading G5 inputs alone never enables jitter
jitter.projection: For row vectors Pj=P*J, J.M41=2*jitterPixels.x/width, J.M42=2*jitterPixels.y/height; J otherwise identity
jitter.clip: Equivalent to clip.xy += jitterNdc*clip.w; z and w unchanged
jitter.culling: Camera logical projection, picking and culling remain unjittered; draw color/depth share render projection
jitter.configurationChange: Pattern/version/amplitude/enable changes invalidate history, unlike normal per-sample jitter
jitter.upstreamMakeUp: AA_TYPE>1 adds jitter; AA_TYPE=1 only resolves without geometric jitter. The 16 phases repeat four (+0.5,+0.5),(-0.5,-0.5),(-0.5,+0.5),(+0.5,-0.5) NDC numerators divided by extent; equivalent physical pixel offsets are +/-0.25, not +/-0.5

inputs.fallback: actual render projection, even when history is invalid
actual current jitter; zero when jitter is disabled
